name: How long does a serious head injury claim take to resolve?

mainEntity.name: How long does a serious head injury claim take to resolve?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a serious head injury claim varies significantly based on several factors, including the severity of the injury, the complexity of liability, and the willingness of all parties to negotiate. Some cases may settle within several months, especially if liability is clear and damages are well-documented. More complex cases involving extensive medical treatment, ongoing recovery, or disputing parties can take years to resolve. Your attorney can provide a more specific timeline after assessing your case.
acceptedAnswer.description: The resolution time for a serious head injury claim varies greatly, from several months to years, depending on injury severity, liability complexity, and negotiation willingness.
